item.title: Kunes acquires auto dealerships in Twin Cities and Chicago’s North Shore area
item.description: Delavan-based Kunes Auto & RV Group announced today that it has acquired two auto dealerships in the Twin Cities area and another in the North Shore area of suburban Chicago. item.title: California-based investment advisory firm acquires Lake Geneva firm
item.description: Newport Beach, California-based Beacon Pointe Advisors announced today that it has acquired three registered investment advisory firms, including Voyager Wealth Management in Lake Geneva. Beacon Pointe announced that it has also acquired firms in Massachusetts and Texas. item.title: New Berlin-based IEWC acquires cable distributor and manufacturer Simcona
item.description: New Berlin-based IEWC has acquired Rochester, New York-based Simcona, strengthening its OEM and Controls business units.

item.title: Watertown-based Thermo-Tech acquired by Ohio-based building products company
item.description: Thermo-Tech Mechanical Installation has been acquired by Columbus, Ohio-based Installed Building Products (IBP) for an undisclosed price.

item.title: New farmer’s market planned for Delafield
item.description: A new farmers market is in the works at 345 Nashotah Road in Delafield. The market is planned to operate seasonally on a 10-acre lot currently home to trailer and lawn mower dealer Bil-Bar Equipment, according to city documents. item.title: Forward BIOLABS announces grant recipients as part of biohealth tech hub initiative
item.description: Forward BIOLABS has announced an initial round of 18 biohealth companies that will each receive funding to help commercialize their innovations.
